description: Capture (Screenshot). Browser-like Screenshot API that captures webpages as PNG/JPEG/WebP or PDF for previews, QA, reporting, monitoring, and archiving no headless setup. Credit cost: 1 credit per call.

block_resources.description: Comma-separated list of resource types to block (e.g., “image,stylesheet,font”). Allowed values: document, eventsource, fetch, font, image, manifest, media, other, script, stylesheet, texttrack, websocket, xhr.

block_urls.description: Comma-separated list of URL patterns to block (e.g., “analytics,tracking,advertisement”).

cache_ttl.description: Cache the response for a custom TTL (in seconds). Default: 2592000.

delay.description: Delay in seconds before capturing the screenshot. Default: 0.

device.description: The device type to emulate for the screenshot. Allowed values: galaxy_fold4, galaxy_s23, galaxy_s23_ultra, galaxy_s8, huawei_mate_50_pro, huawei_p60_pro, ipad, iphone_12, iphone_13_mini, iphone_13_pro_max, iphone_14_pro, iphone_14_pro_max, iphone_x, pixel_5, pixel_6a, pixel_7_pro, redmi_note_11, redmi_note_12_pro.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

format.description: The output format of the screenshot. Allowed values: jpeg, jpg, pdf, png, webp. Default: "png".

full_page.description: Capture the entire page instead of just the visible viewport. Default: false.

full_page_scroll.description: Scroll the page to fully load lazy-loaded elements before capturing a full-page screenshot. Default: false.

full_page_scroll_duration.description: Time in milliseconds for scrolling before capturing the full page. Default: 400.

image_quality.description: Generate images with custom quality settings. Default: "80".

proxy.description: Specify a proxy server to route your request through.

remove_ads.description: Automatically remove ads before capturing. Default: false.

remove_cookie_banners.description: Automatically remove cookie banners before capturing. Default: false.

remove_selectors.description: A comma-separated list of elements to hide before capturing (e.g., ads, popups).

s3_bucket.description: The S3 bucket name where the screenshot will be uploaded.

s3_object_key.description: The filename for the S3 object (auto-generated if not provided).

s3_url.description: Use S3 storage for screenshots. The S3 URL will be returned in the response. Default: false.

scale_factor.description: The scale factor for high-resolution screenshots. Default: 1.

selector.description: Capture a specific element on the page instead of the full viewport.

storage_endpoint.description: Leave this field empty for AWS S3. Only specify a value if required. S3-compatible storage services are supported, for example, use https://<accountId>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com for Cloudflare R2.

url.description: The URL of the webpage to capture. Examples:  https://www.amazon.com/s?k=pokemon

viewport_height.description: The height of the browser viewport in pixels. Default: 1024.

viewport_width.description: The width of the browser viewport in pixels. Default: 1280.

wait_for_selector.description: Wait for a specific element to appear before taking the screenshot.

wait_until.description: Define when to capture. Allowed values: domcontentloaded, load, networkidle0, networkidle2.

name: capture
title: Capture (Screenshot)
